reviewed_by: Static review of retained Binary Ninja, Radare2 and angr entry evidence against the current function body
scope: Exact function entry, single-block control flow, global read and EAX return. Runtime scope is limited to the recorded angr VEX differential cases.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Binary Ninja and Radare2 evidence identify retail entry 0x00402880; angr CFGFast recovers the exact entry. The candidate function is the address-bound Game_GetContext implementation.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: Retail instructions read a global and return; no stack arguments are read. The candidate declaration takes no arguments.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: The sole global address is 0x00567C8C, exactly matching the retail MOV EAX,[0x00567C8C]. No scaling is present.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: One four-byte global read is observed; the current source returns DAT_00567C8C without other memory accesses.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: The retail body has no calls or writes; source body has no calls or writes.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: Single path ends in RET after loading the global into EAX. Eight angr VEX differential cases matched the EAX value and observed memory state.

limitations: The source-level pointer type is not established by the retail instructions; only the four-byte return register behavior is established.
The differential uses angr VEX on retail and candidate images, not live IGI/Frida.
